Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with Microsoft BI expertise. 
 What you will do: 
 You will participate in the different phases of Digital Transformation Projects by designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI. 
Your work will directly impact decision-making processes within the organization, driving data-driven strategies and initiatives.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements, objectives, and key performance indicators (KPIs). 
Design and develop interactive and visually appealing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI. 
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into Power BI for analysis. 
Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights, and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
Optimize and maintain existing Power BI dashboards and reports, ensuring data accuracy and relevance. 
Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather data from various departments and integrate it into a cohesive view. 
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, best practices, and tools related to data visualization and analytics. 
Participate in data quality and validation efforts to ensure accurate and reliable reporting. 
Provide training and support to end users, enabling them to utilize Power BI effectively for their analytical needs. 
Contribute to the development and implementation of data governance and data security policies. 
Collaborate with data engineers and database administrators to ensure data integrity and efficient data retrieval.
 What you need to have: 
Advanced SQL, DAX, MDX and Query performance tuning.
Very good Knowledge on Design Pattern of Data Product.
Demonstrate ability to manage multiple interfaces & deal with IT resources in international context.
Familiar with fully automated CI/CD Pipelines (Azure DevOps) for code deployment, integration and test automation, code quality and orchestration for automated build and release. 
Ability to manage Row Level Security on each Layer of the data Chain.
Experience Building and Interacting with Data Lake Solutions.
Good knowledge on agile methodology.
Working with stakeholders including data, design, product and executive teams and assisting them with data-related technical issues.
Build Data Cubes.
Maintain the ETL in operational condition.
Working with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to support their data infrastructure needs while assisting with data-related technical issues.
Familiarity with distributed query engines such as Trino (or equivalent). 
Knowledge of object storage systems such as MinIO (or equivalent) and distributed SQL query engines such as Trino. 
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including the medallion architecture • Support the qualification of the projects, extraction, transformation and load of the data (Data Scoping / Discovery).
Technical Framing: Feasibility study, expression of needs, estimation of the load and timeframe.
Writing Technical Specifications.
Ensure documentation of achievements.
Proficiency in creating visually compelling and interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI. 
Strong understanding of data visualization principles and best practices. 
Solid knowledge of data analysis techniques, ETL processes, and data modeling concepts.
Familiarity with SQL and database querying for data extraction and transformation. 
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
